rv.t: Moraine Lake in Alberta is truly breathtaking and widely considered one of the most beautiful lakes in the world for a reason. The turquoise water, dramatic mountain backdrop, and peaceful scenery make it feel almost unreal. There’s a short hike up to a viewpoint, and the reward is absolutely worth it. The view from the top is majestic and gives you that iconic postcard-perfect look over the lake. There’s also a…

As a part of my Sperm Donation World Tour of Canada, coming here using the bus connecter from Lake Louise I got here late in the afternoon so imagining it wasnt as busy. What another magical must see spot to tick off the bucket list. So beautiful.

Moraine Lake is the real deal, those turquoise waters set against the Valley of the Ten Peaks are unforgettable. Do your homework before you go: personal vehicles aren’t allowed, so book your Parks Canada shuttle or a private operator in advance. The lakeside loop is worth every step.

rv.t: I love how quiet, relaxing, and refreshing Ibiza is in the wintertime. These photos were taken in January, no crowds, just a peaceful, local vibe to enjoy this paradisiacal island in its purest form.

Ibiza is a truly beautiful island, full of life. It is so colorful, so loud, so enthusiastic, so happy. It was an experience that will be a lifetime memory. It is the place where you can either party like you will never again in your life, or you can relax and enjoy on the beach and in the beautiful nature. It is up to you, but Ibiza has it all.

During a trip to Spain, Italy and France, we stayed 1 day at Ibiza. It was my first time and I LOVED IT! Beautiful beaches and nice people. Full of happiness and relaxation! For sure I'll visit there at least twice a year!

rv.t: Myconos is fabulous. Food is great, people are friendly and Paradise Beach is so much fun. Party time.

Had a great time on the island of Mikonos, in the Aegean Sea. We took a cruise ship, the Celestyal Discovery, to tour several of the islands in the area. Mikonos was the first stop, and it set the tone for the rest of the cruise. The seaside town has many of the iconic whitewashed limestone houses, a bustling shopping and restaurant area, and the sunset from the beach was beautiful. We spent several hours in the…
Great place to visit, lots of little narrow streets with a good mix of restaurants and shops.

rv.t: We used the private van service from our airport to accommodation in Cappadocia and then again back to a different airport. Communication throughout the organising and booking process was quick and clear. Other tour promotions were suggested which we did not take up but handy to know. The big vans were very spacious, the driver was on time each time to the minute which is appreciated while travelling. Got to our…

Amazing view and unique landscape. The hiking trail can be a bit confusing. Using a good hiking app will definitely help. Pity there were quite a lot trash along the trails. Please bring your waste with you to protect this beautiful place.

Love Valley in Cappadocia is a must-visit for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and those looking for one of the best panoramic views in the region. There is an entrance fee of 50 lira per car, but once inside, parking is free. One of the best times to visit is early in the morning when hot air balloons fill the sky, creating an unforgettable scene. It’s a popular viewpoint for watching the sunrise with the magical…

2107.a: Japan, 〒389-1316 Nagano, Kamiminochi District, Shinano, Oi, 2576 Earthboat Kurohime

2107.ed: Visitors say this glamping facility offers a unique escape into nature with clean, stylish cabins and private wood-fired saunas. They also highlight the serene atmosphere, beautiful lake views, and the opportunity to enjoy stargazing and outdoor activities like BBQ. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, along with practical amenities such as coffee service and well-maintained restrooms.
2107.edj: このグランピング施設を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、清潔でおしゃれなキャビンとプライベートな薪焚きサウナが、自然の中で特別な時間を過ごせるとして高く評価されています。また、穏やかな雰囲気や美しい湖の景色、満点の星空、バーベキューなどのアウトドアアクティビティも魅力のようです。気の利くスタッフや、コーヒーサービス、手入れの行き届いたトイレなどの設備も好評です。

rv.t: We are from HK travelling with 2 Shibas. It’s our first stay in Earthboat. It was a great and unforgettable experience and memorable stay in such an amazing nature surrounded cabin witb Sauna! Nice lake view from the cabin as well. We would definitely visit other locations of Earthboat next time.

We went there to be in quite nature and enjoy slow time with in sauna when the weather getting cooler. Fortunately, we managed to book it during 紅葉season. The cabin is quite spacious and functional. My Finnish husband approved the authentic sauna. We love how it is so quiet and enjoy being ourselves. Since it was raining a lot, we wish we have more fire starter to start the fire. We love it so much that we already…

Magical cabin surrounded by nature. Quiet, beautiful, well organised, clean, with all needed comfort. The wood fire saunas attached to each cabin is an amazing experience. The team is very helpful while being very discret giving the whole stay the feeling to be away from everything

2108.a: Japan, 〒781-4222 Kochi, Kami, Kahokucho Ioroi, 古川1881-1 allbeans KOCHI
2108.aj: 〒781-4222 高知県香美市香北町五百蔵古川１８８１−１ allbeans KOCHI

rv.t: 4月16日つばき利用 チェックインはメールで番号が送られてきます。 2棟あるコンテナホテル、一泊3万くらいでした。 駐車場あり、ハエとハチ、小蝿はいますが蚊はいませんでした。天候は晴れ、季節も良くエアコンなしで過ごせました。 近くのスーパーで新鮮な卵、新玉ねぎ、スナップエンドウ、文旦と土佐赤牛、はちきん地鳥を買っていきました。焚き火は有料ですが楽しかったです。冷蔵庫と小さな冷凍スペースもあります。 雨の場合はベッドでゴロゴロ過ごす。

一名で利用させて頂きました。 デジタルデトックス…とまではいきませんでしたが、景色がとても良くて、ゆっくりとした時間を過ごしました。晴れていれば、プラネタリウム顔負けの星空を独り占めできます。 調理器具は一通り揃っているので、ちょっとしたご飯を作るには充分すぎるくらいでした。 晩ご飯は近くの「おすそわけ食堂 まど」さんのお弁当を食べました。もちろん取り組みに共感したのもありますが、前提としてとても美味しく、注文して正解でした。 晩ご飯後は友人と焚き火を囲み、話をしたりマシュマロでスモアを作ったりしました。 晩から朝にかけてとても寒く、雪が降るレベルでしたが、備え付けのヒーター＋エアコンで充分暖は取れます。エアコンはあげすぎなくても良いかもです。 トイレはコンポスト形式なので、若干臭いが気にならないわけではないですが、冬でしたらキャンプされる方は気にならないかと思います。…

木の温もりを感じられる室内で、とてもリラックス出来ました！木目を見ながらぼーっとできたのが良かったです。 調理道具も一通り揃っていて、具材を持ち込んで自分たちで焚き火で焼いたり、お部屋で調理出来たのが楽しかったです！ 食器も割れにくい素材なのか使いやすく、とてもおしゃれで、ただのじゃがいもが一段と美味しそうに見えました！ 窓も広く、自然の中で寝ているような感覚になれました。小窓には網戸がついているため、そこから外の虫や鳥の声が聞こえて癒されました…！ シャワーが真上からくるヘッドと、ノーマルのヘッドがあったのも面白かったです。真上からの方は初体験でした！ 暑い夏でしたが、朝6時くらいは涼しくて、外の椅子に座って静かに時間を過ごすことができました！ とっても素敵なお宿でした！充実した時間をありがとうございます。また来たいです✨️

rv.t: The Japanese Covered Bridge is undoubtedly the most iconic landmark in Hội An and one of the town’s biggest attractions. As expected, it draws large crowds throughout the day, with visitors constantly stopping to admire the historic architecture and take photos. If you’re visiting during peak hours, be prepared for a steady stream of tourists crossing the bridge and gathering around its entrances. Despite its modest…

Pure magic after dark! The historic Pagoda Bridge is beautiful, the entire area completely transforms at night. The glowing lanterns along the river, the bustling energy of the night market, and the vibrant street life create an unforgettable atmosphere. It's incredibly scenic and a total must-visit destination!

The Pagoda Bridge in Hoi An is a beautiful landmark that perfectly captures the charm and rich heritage of the ancient town. Its unique architecture and historic significance make it a must-visit attraction. In the evening, the area comes alive with glowing lanterns, creating a truly magical atmosphere. Releasing a lantern on the river near the bridge was one of the most memorable experiences of our visit. Watching…

rv.t: Hoi An is truly a magical city that feels like stepping into a living postcard. The beautifully preserved Ancient Town, glowing lanterns, and charming yellow buildings create an atmosphere that is both peaceful and romantic. Walking through the streets, especially in the evening, is an unforgettable experience as the city lights up with colors reflecting on the Thu Bon River. The city offers a perfect blend of…

Hoi An, Ancient Town, the city of lanterns! This is my 2nd time here, and I would probably come back, because I love it SO much!!! The colours, the friendly people, how fast the shop owners can make you something, the food...just everything!! Highly recommend making this city part of your travel itinerary!

We had an amazing experience at Duck Stop Hoi An, and Nhat made it even more memorable! He was incredibly friendly, energetic, and made everyone feel welcome from the moment we arrived. He explained everything clearly, helped us take great photos, and kept the atmosphere fun and entertaining throughout the visit. The duck feeding and duck massage were hilarious, and Nhat’s enthusiasm made the whole experience…

rv.t: The Lantern Night Market is absolutely mesmerising. The view at night is stunning, with lanterns lighting up the entire place and creating a magical atmosphere. The boat ride is a must-do—peaceful, beautiful, and perfectly timed for the evening glow. The food options are fantastic, with something for everyone, and everything we tried was delicious. Overall, it’s an amazing experience and the perfect place to spend…

It was a memorable experience. We were told it was better after dark and it certainly was very beautiful. We were also told about the people being pushy to get you to buy candles or go on the boats. They were very persistent. Thankfully the markets were gentler in their sales pitch. I found a huge variety of things to buy and I'm very pleased with my purchases. The atmosphere was friendly inviting. Check expected…

Vietnam's 'old city' or 'old town' experience also includes Hanoi's Old Quarter, a 'thousand year old' bustling district of 36 trade streets, and a 15th to the19th C trading port. Both offer traditional crafts, and a 'happy - go - lucky' street life while depicting French colonial touch. It is located between Hoan Kiem Lake, the Red River, and the old city wall. Known as the '36 streets', it originated in the 11th…

rv.t: love the vibe of the little coffee shop. wonderful iced v60, the viet beans are aromatic, smooth and balanced. not to mention unbeatable price for a hand drip. you can get a real glimpse of hanoi coffee scene here where people simply sit on the street chilling. will definitely come back!
Surprisingly great coffee. Their Son La Vietnamese coffee beans have an exquisite taste. Bravo to the roasters. Expect a very small seating area, yet cozy and lovely.

10/10 Hanoi alley vibe. Very lovely space but with limited seating - group of 3 max. Both their matcha and chocolate taste good. Only 1 downside is they dont have toilet - understandable for their size.

2114.a: Tranquil Books & Coffee - 5 Nguyễn Quang Bích, 5 P. Nguyễn Quang Bích, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2114.aj: Tranquil Books & Coffee - 5 Nguyễn Quang Bích, 5 P. Nguyễn Quang Bích, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム

rv.t: Tranquil Nguyen Quang Bich is one of my favorite coffee spots in Hanoi. This spot is super cozy, peaceful, and filled with books, which makes it the perfect place to read and relax. I especially love the upstairs area with the sofas, bookshelves, and candlelight in the evening,.. Everything feels really warm and charming. There was one time they ran out of matcha, which is my favourite drink here. They recommended…

Love this place ! I had such a pleasant evening at the open mic event. It’s quite small inside but it makes it more intimate. Just if you want to get a sit inside when there’s an event, you should try to come early :) The staff was really nice and helpful as they were trying to accommodate everyone. Nice selection of original alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks, I really enjoyed my cold brew !

Truly tranquil, superb coffee (with paid oatmilk option) in a very calm, cozy and spacious cafe 😍 Books, wifi, water, WC all available, great place to chill solo or meet as a group! Cute concepts like a shoes-off upper floor and a "book map", really wonderful service and experience overall, happy to come back!! 😘👍🏻

rv.t: A great coffee place in Hanoi that’s probably my favorite so far! It’s super spacious with several floors to choose from. The coffee was good, but the highlight for me was their amazing banana bread. The interior is so stylish and gives off the best vibes. I loved it 💕I spent a few hours working there, so it’s perfect if you’re looking for a spot to do remote work. Would definitely recommend!

Giao Mua Cafe in Hanoi offers a truly unique experience, reminiscent of stepping into a cozy hobbit house. The cafe’s design is unlike any other in the city, with its small, earthy nooks and rounded doorways that create a whimsical, storybook atmosphere. The rustic decor, warm lighting, and lush greenery add to the charm, making you feel like you’ve entered a hidden forest cottage. The menu is just as delightful…
Went here with my family recently. Had to try their coffee/pastries for a quick break from exploring Old Quarter area. Glad we found it. Love the interior, it’s a vibe! Coffee’s good! Must Visit. :)

2116.a: Coffee A, 02 P. Lãn Ông, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2116.aj: Coffee A, 02 P. Lãn Ông, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム

rv.t: As an egg coffee lover, I was excited to give it a try in this bustling old quarter. Unfortunately, the coffee itself was quite average. The only highlight for me was the balcony view, which offered a nice vantage point to watch the lively street below.
Had Tea, Coffee and a Banana Cake. All were really good. But it’s about the views and the fact that you can observe a really busy street crossing. Really cool!
Took the traditional bahn mi and Bac Siu Coffee. Both were delicious, ample pâté with pickled radish in the banh mi. Food here is better than Cafés with "5.0" reviews.

rv.t: After the show at Tokyo Dome, we chose Haremai Tei Izakaya for our gathering, and the banquet set menu exceeded all expectations! The food was varied and tasty, and the atmosphere was amazing—perfect for a post-event meal.
Great food and excellent service! The atmosphere is cozy and I would definitely come back again.

2118.edj: このカフェを訪れた人は、美味しいホットサンド、カレー、ソフトクリームを高く評価しています。また、豊富な種類のドリンクやデザートも好評のようです。店内は清潔で快適な空間で、居心地の良い暖炉があり、リラックスできる雰囲気だというクチコミが多くあります。スタッフは親切で感じが良く、心地よい時間を過ごせるといった感想があります。

rv.t: Stylish cafè with many types of coffee from all over the world, it serves also some dishes, but my personal favourite was their ice cream, absolutely delicious! They also have a nice view down the valley which is a plus. Go-to place if in Nasu Yumoto Onsen.
Devine drip coffee and a must-stop to experience this coffee shop! Food looks delicious.
Very comfortable cafe environment, polite staff and nice avocado cheese bacon toast.

This kind of situation happened to me twice, both times with young female staff members who clearly need more training in Japanese hospitality.
They offer seasonal items but the original flavor cheese start will not disappoint.

catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2120.ed: Visitors say this cafe offers unique coffee experiences and delicious desserts like rich cassata, along with a wide variety of seating options. They also highlight the spacious, quiet, and artistic atmosphere, noting it's ideal for focused work or relaxation with good Wi-Fi and power outlets. Other reviews mention the service can be slow.
2120.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ユニークなコーヒー体験や、濃厚なカッサータのような美味しいデザートが高く評価されています。また、様々な種類の座席が用意されているようです。広々としていて静かな、芸術的な雰囲気も特徴で、Wi-Fiや電源も利用できるため、集中して作業したり、リラックスしたりするのに理想的だという声もあります。 一方で、サービスが遅いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Great café. They have special kinds of coffee with funny names. I tried one of them for ¥600 and it tasted really good. The place is quite spacious, with a cozy atmosphere, vintage furniture and art everywhere. They also sell zines and albums of some indie bands.

Love this cafe. Very spacious, lots of natural light, tasty coffee and desserts. A great place to meet with a friend or to get some studying or reading done. The art exhibit in the back was nice, and they have plays on the first floor. I’ll be back!

What a cool place. It’s rare to find these kind of cafes that put so much detail into the atmosphere without feeling pretentious. There is art on display, magazines and books to take, and a delicious chai. This is one of my favorite cafes!

2121.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious, authentic coffee, which is brewed using a siphon, and its wide variety of homemade cakes and toasts. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the cozy, retro atmosphere. Guests mention the staff, an older couple, provide warm and attentive service.
2121.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、サイフォンで淹れた本格的で美味しいコーヒーと、種類豊富な自家製ケーキやトーストが高く評価されています。手頃な価格設定と、居心地の良いレトロな雰囲気も特徴のようです。また、年配の夫婦である店主が温かく丁寧なサービスを提供しているという声が多くあります。

rv.t: Pretty little kissaten in Kitasenju. We were lucky one of the table just emptied when we get in. While inside, people came several times but rejected by the server since the table were fully occupied. The owner were nice, the server was sweet, and the atmosphere was lovely. Would love to come here again when our child has grown up.

LOVED this cafe! Only a small place with maybe 8/9 tables but lovely atmosphere. The couple that run it are so lovely and friendly, the service is amazing and the coffee and food delicious. The pizza toast was my favourite - so tasty. Can’t recommend this place enough and it’s in a lovely, quiet district which we enjoyed wandering around after.
Small, cozy place. I recommend it. Also fun to hear the owners had visited my country in the past. I hope i could repay my gratitude with a piece from my home 🍫

2122.aj: 〒120-0034 東京都足立区千住２丁目 49番2号 韓国酒場 乾杯食堂 37Eビル1F
2122.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and authentic Korean dishes, especially the thick samgyeopsal, crispy kimchi jeon, and flavorful fried chicken. They also highlight the reasonable prices, all-you-can-drink options, and the lively atmosphere with K-pop music videos. Guests mention the staff are attentive and friendly, often cooking the samgyeopsal at the table.
2122.edj: この韓国料理店を利用した人は、本格的で美味しい韓国料理を高く評価しています。特に、分厚いサムギョプサル、カリカリのキムチチヂミ、味付けの良いフライドチキンがおすすめとして挙げられています。また、手頃な価格設定や飲み放題のオプション、K-POPのミュージックビデオが流れる賑やかな雰囲気も好評のようです。スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応をしてくれるというクチコミが多く、サムギョプサルをテーブルで焼いてくれるサービスも喜ばれています。

rv.t: Small restaurant, easy to order cause you just need to read the QR code, food was okay, the honey garlic chicken was surprisingly tasty, it was not too crowded on a Saturday night when we went.
Great place for real Korean Fried chicken and other traditional dishes. A cool atmosphere and conveniently located.
Really delicious pork, served in typical Korean style. The kinpa was amazing! Excellent service and staff 🙏.

2123.a: Japan, 〒120-0026 Tokyo, Adachi City, Senjuasahicho, 42−1 北千住駅構内 2階 いぶきうどんエキア北千住 コンコース
2123.aj: 〒120-0026 東京都足立区千住旭町４２−１ 北千住駅構内 2階 いぶきうどんエキア北千住 コンコース
2123.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious, chewy udon noodles and flavorful iriko dashi broth, with many praising the variety of tempura options. They also highlight the reasonable prices, quick service, and free self-serve toppings like ginger, green onions, and iriko tsukudani. Other reviews mention the noodles can be soft.
2123.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくてもちもちしたうどん麺と風味豊かないりこ出汁のつゆが高く評価されています。また、豊富な種類の天ぷらも好評のようです。手頃な価格、迅速なサービス、そして無料のセルフサービスで利用できる生姜、青ネギ、いりこ佃煮などのトッピングも特筆されています。 一方で、麺が柔らかいという意見もあります。

rv.t: Quick service udon joint located inside Kita Senju station on the upper concourse area. House made noodles have the perfect bite and the light bodied broth is packed with fish umami. Great bang for buck.
The best! Very good!

北千住駅構内にある「いぶきうどん」、改札外東武線の改札口付近に店舗はあります。 入り口前に券売機、入店後に食券を渡して完成を待ちます！今回はかけのスペシャルと牛丼をお願いしました！ 茹でたてのうどん、揚げたての天ぷら、そしてツユはいりこ出汁がとっても出ていて非常に美味しかったです♪ セルフでネギや生姜などを入れられますが、そこにいりこの出汁で使い終わっただしがらを再利用して佃煮にしてあるのですが、コレがまた美味い‼︎ うどんにもご飯にも合うので最高です！ ごちそうさまでした‼︎

2124.a: 豚is赤黒, 44-13 Senjuasahicho, Adachi City, Tokyo 120-0026, Japan
2124.aj: 〒120-0026 東京都足立区千住旭町４４−１３ 豚is赤黒
2124.ed: Diners like this Korean restaurant's authentic and delicious dishes, especially the juicy samgyeopsal and crispy jeon. They also highlight the generous all-you-can-eat side dishes, including fresh vegetables and kimchi, and the reasonable prices. Guests mention the staff are friendly, attentive, and create a welcoming atmosphere.
2124.edj: この韓国料理店を訪れた人は、本格的で美味しい料理を高く評価しています。特に、ジューシーなサムギョプサルとカリカリのチヂミが好評です。新鮮な野菜やキムチを含む、おかわり自由なサイドディッシュが豊富で、価格も手頃であるというクチコミが多くあります。スタッフは親切で気配りができ、居心地の良い雰囲気を作っているという意見もあります。

rv.t: Service is good and very clean. Lively atmosphere, staff is nice 😊
It was a nice moment and a memory for the birthday celebration! It has a very authentic Korean taste!

地元にある韓国料理屋さんで毎日ランチで行ってますが土曜日の夜に２回目でしたが行ってきました。 お酒苦手な3人でソフトドリンクで乾杯^_^ 一推しサムギョプサル絶品^_^ 海鮮チヂミ 香ばしくて美味しい^_^ サラダ 冷奴入っていて暑い日には最高^_^ チャプチェ めっちゃ美味しい^_^ 最後締めでチャーハン(写真忘れた💦) めっちゃ美味しく頂きました。 大満足でした。 スタッフさんもフレンドリーで優しくて気配り素敵です。

2124.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2125.a: Japan, 〒120-0034 Tokyo, Adachi City, Senju, 1 Chome−28−13 HANOI&HANOI ハーブとベトナム料理
2125.aj: 〒120-0034 東京都足立区千住１丁目２８−１３ HANOI&HANOI ハーブとベトナム料理
2125.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and unique Vietnamese dishes, especially the flavorful pho, banh mi, and fresh spring rolls, which come with generous portions of fresh herbs. They also highlight the cozy, authentic, and charming atmosphere, saying it feels like being in Vietnam. Guests mention the staff are warm, attentive, and provide excellent explanations of the menu.
2125.edj: フォーやパクチーサラダなど、各種ベトナム料理を提供している。ベトナムコーヒーなどのドリンク類の種類は豊富。

rv.t: Highly recommend Bun Cha basically Vietnamese version of cold noodle dish Absolutely Delicious. The owner seems to be nice and sweet as well. Wish she had sweet and sour dipping sauce for her rice perp roll.

We stumbled into this restaurant right before it was about to close for the day, and wow. The service, the smiles, the conversation with the owner, the atmosphere, and of course the food were all great. The price vs quality (コスパ)is incredible. I think if I were to add any comments, I’d love to get a bit more ‘punch’ from the pho stock. I felt like something exciting was missing from the bowl of pho I’m used to…

Wonderful food experience. It was our 3rd attempt to dine in and we finally got in! Small place, not much tables so I highly recommend to reserve. Everything was tasty and I can tell that it’s probably the best Vietnamese restaurant in town. Huge thumbs up for this place and looking forward to going again.

2126.a: Japan, 〒120-0034 Tokyo, Adachi City, Senju, 2 Chome−61 牛たんささ川 北千住店 ビックリヤ北千住西口ビル 4F
2126.aj: 〒120-0034 東京都足立区千住２丁目６１ 牛たんささ川 北千住店 ビックリヤ北千住西口ビル 4F

rv.t: 牛たん好きなので食べたくなると伺うお店です。お店の雰囲気は落ち着いた内装です。夜にしか伺ったことはありませんが隣のお客さんにより雰囲気が変わりますね。まずお通しが美味しい。後で日本酒のおつまみにと思っちゃいます。牛たんが柔らかくてぷりっとしてる。定食は若い子にはおすすめ。夜もあります。私はピザが好きです。生樽の日本酒美味しかったです。 接客は丁寧ですがドリンクの提供が遅くて声を何度かかけさせて頂きました。お酒と楽しみたいのでお酒が長い時間途切れると帰ろうか。となります
日曜日の13時頃にランチで利用しました。 来店してすぐに席に案内されました。 店内はゆったり落ち着いた雰囲気で店員の方も感じがよかったです。 定食のライスとテールスープはおかわりできるとのこと。このテールスープがとても美味しかったです。 お料理も丁度いい量でとても美味しかったです。また北千住に行った際には利用しようと思います。

rv.a: あじこ〜東京飲み歩きログ〜
rv.t: 休日のランチで訪れました。 北千住の駅前で美味しい牛タンがリーズナブルに食べられる？本当に？と疑いながら入りましたが、良い意味で裏切られました。 ジューシーで甘みのある牛タン、それに合わせるタレがまたおいしく、ビール飲みたいな〜なんて思いながら、ご飯をもりもり食べました。 夜だけではなく、昼飲みもできるようでランチメニューの他にももつ鍋やその他もろもろいろんなメニューがあり、ちょっといい居酒屋といった印象でした。 カウンターもあり、ランチ時間は1人客もちらほらいらっしゃったり、静かで落ち着いた雰囲気のように感じました。 店員さんも対応が親切で、また機会があれば利用させていただきたいと思いました。

2126.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

2127.a: King Tacos, 3 Chome-1-1 Ginowan, Okinawa 901-2211, Japan
2127.aj: 〒901-2211 沖縄県宜野湾市宜野湾３丁目１−１ キングタコス 長田店
catj: タコス レストラン
ファースト フード店
2127.ed: People say this restaurant offers generous portions of delicious tacos and taco rice, with a perfect balance of crispy tortillas, flavorful meat, and fresh vegetables. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the convenience of late operating hours. Others also say the spicy salsa sauce is excellent and that the parking is ample.
2127.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、ボリュームたっぷりの美味しいタコスとタコライスを高く評価しています。サクサクのトルティーヤ、風味豊かな肉、新鮮な野菜のバランスが完璧というクチコミが多くあります。また、手頃な価格と遅い時間まで営業している利便性も好評のようです。スパイシーなサルサソースが絶品という声や、駐車場が広いという意見もあります。

rv.t: I am not a big fan of okinawan tacos but this legendary shop is different story!! The only tacos i can enjoy in Okinawa.. the tacos sauce is just very good!!! So delicious. So much meat and cheese. The minus is far from city center. Price is cheap. Very recommended. Theres a parking lot as well. But theres no seat if you want to dine in. Its just table and you have to stand.

This is a famous taco restaurant with several chain restaurants in Okinawa. The tacos and taco rice are wonderfully seasoned and served. The restaurant is mainly a take-out restaurant, so there is almost no waiting time after ordering. To order, buy a meal ticket from the ticket machine located just inside the restaurant and hand it to the waiter.

Iconic Okinawan taco rice! Actually came to this store because of Attaché, but a must try nevertheless. Limited parking here, but appears to be street parking as well. Ordering process is easy enough, just wait for your number to be called. The taco rice was pretty much as expected, tasty enough for a simple lunch.

2127.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

2128.aj: 〒905-0004 沖縄県名護市中山９０ 百年古家 大家
catj: しゃぶしゃぶレストラン
2128.ed: Forest-hugged spot serving soba noodles in a wood-clad dining room & al fresco with waterfall views.
2128.edj: 木のぬくもりあふれる店内と滝を眺めるテラス席で沖縄そばを楽しめる、森に抱かれたレストラン。

rv.t: One of the nicer lunch experiences of our holiday, the setting felt traditional and memorable without being overly formal. The shabu-shabu and soba were both enjoyable, and the whole atmosphere made the meal feel like part of the Okinawa experience rather than just a stop for food. It is especially good if you want to pair a calm sit-down lunch with a scenic or cultural feeling. Families, couples, and small groups…

Absolutely loved the pork here! Both the pork rice and noodles were super tasty — full of flavor and cooked perfectly. We had to wait around 15–20 minutes when we arrived, but it was totally worth it. The place was buzzing with people, which is always a good sign! The staff were really friendly and attentive. I think they noticed I had a baby with me, so they kindly arranged a private room for us — such a thoughtful…

have had an interesting experience here. the food is great and the historical house may amaze you. you may choose Hotpot or barbecue style. must try their handmade noodles. driving is a must. although we've made a booking, still need to queue. the price is great!

2128.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2129.a: Tacos-ya Shintoshin, 4 Chome-12-13 Omoromachi, Naha, Okinawa 900-0006, Japan
2129.aj: 〒900-0006 沖縄県那覇市おもろまち４丁目１２−１３ タコス屋 新都心店
catj: タコス レストラン
2129.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and crispy tacos, which feature a perfect balance of meat, cheese, and fresh vegetables. They also highlight the "Tacoya Plate" as a great value, offering tacos, taco rice, fries, and onion rings. Guests mention the casual atmosphere and efficient service, making it a convenient spot for a quick and satisfying meal.
2129.edj: このタコス店を利用したユーザーは、肉、チーズ、新鮮な野菜のバランスがとれた、美味しくてクリスピーなタコスを高く評価しています。また、タコス、タコライス、フライドポテト、オニオンリングがセットになった「タコスヤプレート」は、お得感があると評判です。カジュアルな雰囲気と効率的なサービスも好評で、手早く満足のいく食事をするのに便利な場所だと感じているようです。

rv.t: Great tasting Okinawan-style tacos. The shell is deep-fried and similar to a Chalupa, but crunchier. Their hot sauce is around mild-spice. Anyone used to heat can drink that sauce no problem. Also got the taco sticks. Think of them as lumpia with some extra cheese inside. The next time I'm here, I'll try the plate since you get a little of everything (except the sticks). Parking is very limited, but you do get a…

I understand that this place has been around for quite some time and is very popular with the locals - while we were eating, 5-10 people came in for their take-outs. As for us, we ordered their combo plate and some extra tacos. Tacos' shell was deep fried, which I loved, and overall the food was excellent - something that I didn't expect when we just entered the store.
Delicious Okinawa style tacos. The taco rice was okay but I recommend you just stick with the tacos for the best experience. The prices were extremely reasonable and the service was quick.

2129.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2130.a: Kanoto International Trout Fishing Field, 3387, Hinohara, Nishitama District, Tokyo, Tokyo 190-0200, Japan
2130.aj: 〒190-0200 東京都西多摩郡檜原村３３８７ 神戸国際マス釣場
2130.ed: People say this fishing spot offers clear river water and a pleasant, shaded location for fishing, with staff who are helpful and provide guidance for beginners. They also highlight the delicious freshly prepared trout, available as salt-grilled, fried, or aromatic-grilled, and the clean, well-maintained facilities, including restrooms.
2130.edj: この釣り堀を利用した人は、自然の渓流のような環境でニジマス釣りが楽しめると評価しています。施設は清潔で手入れが行き届いており、特にトイレがとてもきれいというクチコミが多くあります。また、スタッフが釣り方などを丁寧に教えてくれるため、初心者や家族連れにもおすすめのようです。釣った魚をその場で塩焼きや唐揚げに調理してもらえる点も好評で、美味しく食べられると喜ばれています。

rv.t: Hidden gem in the middle of Hinohara. We were looking for an authentic fishing activity for the kids and stumbled into this lovely stream. The owners were very friendly and offered us to cook our catch at 3pm, even though we arrived at 2pm. Within minutes, we managed to catch our fish and got a chance to grill our fish. After fishing, we spent the rest of the time admiring the surroundings until it was ready for our…

車のアクセスは中央自動車道「八王子IC」から国道411号経由で約1時間。 圏央道「あきる野IC」または「日の出IC」から約45分。 無料駐車場（約50台）が完備されています。 公共交通機関だと JR武蔵五日市駅から西東京バス「藤倉」行き、または「小岩」行きに乗車（約35分）。 「神戸岩（かのといわ）入口」バス停で下車し、徒歩約5分。 建て直したようで、トイレも食事する場所も綺麗でした。 テラス席もとても気持ちが良いです。 マス釣りとBBQ利用につての詳細 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 基本情報 営業時間: 8:00〜16:00 定休日: 4月〜8月は無休、9月〜3月は水曜定休（※時期により変動があるため、事前に公式サイト等での確認をおすすめします） 自然を活かした釣り場: 秋川の支流である神戸川を利用しており、 自然の渓流に近い雰囲気で釣りが楽しめます。 初心者・ファミリー歓迎…
【一日券3,600円でマス釣り+BBQ可能!!】 ファミリー、カップル、近所のおじちゃん いろんな方がいらっしゃってました 釣ったマスもその場で 塩焼き、唐揚げ、香味焼き 3種類で調理してくれます！ めちゃくちゃ美味しかったです！

2131.a: TOKA COFFEE STAND, 9 Phạm Đình Hổ, Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam
2131.aj: TOKA COFFEE STAND, 9 Phạm Đình Hổ, Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội 100000 ベトナム
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: Honestly, there’s nothing to fault. From the drinks to the service, this place is easily one of the best cafés in Vietnam.

A recommended destination in Hanoi worth exploring is this establishment. Guests have the freedom to choose their seating and effortlessly place orders for beverages at affordable rates. Notably, patrons will encounter a diverse mix of attractive individuals during their visit. I was thoroughly impressed by both the attentive staff, inviting ambiance, and quality of beverages offered at this venue.

TOKA COFFEE STAND is a fantastic spot for coffee lovers seeking quality and simplicity. Located in a convenient yet cozy setting, this coffee stand exudes a minimalist charm that is both inviting and refreshing. The décor is modern and clean, making it an ideal place to enjoy a quick coffee break or a quiet moment of relaxation. The highlight of TOKA COFFEE STAND is its commitment to serving excellent coffee. Their…

catj: ツアー オペレーター
ウォーター スポーツ用品レンタル業

rv.t: Highly recommend going with these guys. We had the best experience. While there are many SUP stations in that area, this one is located a bit further up. And there were hundreds of people swimming together from other SUP stations which looked quite chaotic(you can see how crazy it was with people from other SUP stations while we had a nice and calm experience on one of the photos). We had a pleasant private…

Joined a private sunrise SUP tour followed by a 1:1 surfing lesson. The SUP tour was cool if you want to catch the beautiful sunrise in DaNang. Apart, I absolutely recommend newbies to join the surfing lesson. It was my first time learning surfing so I was both nervous and excited, but TUAN and QUANG were patient and helpful in teaching me the skills and safety of surfing. They were also really friendly and…

PROFESSIONAL, from the beginning to the end. Thanks Tuan for the detailed booking process and things to prepare in advance. Big thanks give to my two instructors, Dat and Tri, who were so professional and dedicated. Thanks to their patient guidance, I managed to stand up and paddle on my very first try. If you want to learn SUP and catch a stunning sủnise in Đà Nẵng, highly recommend the team!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

2133.a: Thành Cổ Sơn Tây, Sơn Tây, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2133.aj: ソンタイ古城 Sơn Tây, Hà Nội, ベトナム
2133.ed: 1800s fort with preserved & restored elements such as a moat, a banyan tree gate & a flag tower.

rv.t: Good place to visit. Currently under renovation, but it will become bigger and better soon.

It is a relatively large park with full of plants and still keeps ancient traces of the old building and foundation. There are plenty of plants with hundreds of y.o which needs to be more protected and conserved.
It's old castle? Anyway this is the location where local people gather and have some activity, reading book and having relax. The building itself looks very old.

2134.a: 5F4C+RXQ Duong Lam Ancient Village, Sơn Tây, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2134.aj: 5F4C+RXQ Duong Lam Ancient Village, Sơn Tây, Hà Nội, ベトナム

rv.t: Great calisthenic workout with the stair climb to the temples. However, once you've reached the top,nothing extraordinary to view. Two things to keep in mind: 1st, A LOT of mosquitoes. So bring your spray. 2nd, it is a definitive climb. So, if you are not in pretty good shape, suffer any cardiac illnesses, or have a equilibrium disability "DO NOT DO THIS".

Good for 1 or 2 days trip. Not many trees in the village so you should bring hat and umbrella with you on summer day. Very convinient to drive from Hanoi (more than 1 hour), so if you have time, it's better to stay here 1 night to live as a villager, enjoy the peaceful moment of the village in the evening.

A place you want to go. Deep history and culture. Friendly locals. Mouthwatering local delicacies. Serenity. Quiet nights. Peaceful reprieve from Hanoi's bustle. Easy to get to. Wonderful homestay hosts. A place you need to go. Patina and textures of time. Colourful and visually rich environs. Relaxing. Just a place that's good for the soul, striking the right balance between preservation and contemporary…

2135.a: 2FV7+CFM Không gian Văn hóa dân tộc Thái, Unnamed, Road, Đoài Phương, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2135.aj: 2FV7+CFM Không gian Văn hóa dân tộc Thái, Unnamed, Road, Đoài Phương, Hà Nội, ベトナム

rv.t: Wheelchair-friendly place. Huge area to travel and always keep someone to push your wheelchair. You can use 6-seater free electric buggies that are available to travel around the main roads. Some places are not wheelchair accessible but you can travel with someone's help. You should use your Toilet needs at the main entrance facilities. Inside the village, Disabled toilets are not clean. Always travel with someone…
Trams are handy, people are very friendly, I wish I could have spent more time here
Nice with activities and gift

2136.a: Chàm Islands, Cham Islands, Da Nang, Vietnam
2136.aj: Cu Lao Cham, Cham Islands, ダナン ベトナム
2136.ed: Offshore islands & nature reserve with picturesque settings for swimming, diving, camping & more.
2136.edj: 沖合に浮かぶ島々。生物圏保護区に指定されている。美しい景観を楽しみながら、海水浴、ダイビング、キャンプなどを楽しめる。

rv.t: It was great. The price was worth it. I was picked up in Danang right at the arranged time. The van was full with little space. It was air-conditioned. The driver was pushy and far from friendly and made feel like cattle being horded. The boat left 30 min late and the boat was filled to maximum. Maybe a bit too full for my comfort. We spent some two hours to explore this beautiful castle and admiring the ancient architectural…

You can reach it by hiking or by riding a Cable Car or Chair Lift for a fee. The Great Sphinx of Giza (Arabic: Abū al-Haul) is a colossal limestone statue of a reclining sphinx—a mythical creature with the body of a lion and the head of a human. It is the oldest known monumental sculpture in Egypt and stands on the Giza Plateau on the west bank of the Nile. In ancient Egypt, the sphinx represented the king with a lion’s body to demonstrate his power and wisdom. Later, during the 18th…

Love it. It’s much more impressive than I expected and definitely one of the highlights of visiting Giza.

For a normal evening out, we probably would’ve chosen the outdoor area which is very lively, but we wanted something more…

It's also one of the best places in Monaco for car spotting. Supercars are constantly passing through…

The famous Hairpin turn in Monaco. Amazed to see so many people standing around this turn just to experience what a F1 drivers feel while racing at Monaco. We experienced it while being inside the public bus.
What a cool spot to see if you're an F1 fan. There is a sidewalk with a low wall and people sit there to watch all of the magnificent cars go by.

rv.t: Prince's Palace of Monaco is an absolutely stunning place to visit and one of the highlights of Monaco. The palace is full of history, elegance, and incredible views overlooking the sea and the city. The atmosphere around the palace feels peaceful, luxurious, and very special. Walking through the area feels like stepping into another world, with beautiful streets, classic architecture, and breathtaking scenery…

The Palace was absolutely wonderful. I wasn't sure what to expect with the low price of admission and how much access there would be to visitors. The rooms we saw on the tour were just beautiful with so much art to enjoy. The highlight of the tour was seeing workers restoring hundreds of years old frescoes. The Prince's Palace was quite enjoyable!

Fantastic experience! The palace was beautiful and the surrounding buildings too. The streets up there are small, clean and so shiny like you are in a movie! I spent a lot of time up the hill because there was Grand Prix in action and you could see some of it from the top! I can’t believe that I accidentally picked the perfect date for my trip!
